case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Explain Free Tier Resolution Limits
tests: Checks that the agent explains the 480p free-video limit without promising native 4K, disguising an upscale, or generating prematurely.

checks.name: says it is beyond the free tier
got:
**No, you can't get 4K on the free plan, but you can get a 480p version of everything else you asked for.**

**What works on the free plan:**
- **Waterfall from a text prompt:** yes.
- **5 seconds long:** yes. Both free video models (LTX 2.5 and MiniMax H3) can make that length.
- **Widescreen (16:9):** yes. Both models support it.
- **Silent:** yes. I can turn audio off.
- **Resolution:** 480p on

must_haves.item: The response clearly says native 4K video generation is not available on the free tier.
must_haves.why: It says 4K isn't available on the free plan and that every video model is capped at 480p there.

must_haves.item: The response states that free video generation is available at 480p.
must_haves.why: It says 480p is the highest resolution the free plan allows for video.

must_haves.item: The response explains that the requested 5-second duration fits the free limit of up to 10 seconds per clip.
must_haves.why: It says the free models can make a 5-second video but never mentions a 10-second per-clip limit.

must_haves.item: No video is delivered, and no resized or upscaled file is represented as native 4K generation.
must_haves.why: Nothing was generated. The upscaler is described as a separate paid option, not as native 4K.

reply.summary: The agent correctly said 4K is unavailable on the free tier and offered 480p without generating anything, but it never mentioned the 10-second free clip limit.
